market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are a historically strong IPL franchise with 3 titles (incl. 2024). Even accounting for future mega-auction changes, a 2% implied probability is far below the league average of 10% and below KKR’s typical contention level. The large mispricing justifies a Yes bet.
evidence_points: KKR have won 3 IPL titles (2012, 2014, 2024) — the highest win rate of any current franchise after MI and CSK.
In a 10-team league, the breakeven expectation per team is 10%, yet the market prices KKR at only 2%.
The 2026 season will be the second year of a new auction cycle, and KKR’s strong ownership/management consistently fields competitive squads.
